checks.command: /bin/zsh -lc "pwd && git status --short --branch && git remote -v && git log -1 --format='%H%n%T%n%P%n%D' && sed -n '1,240p' /Users/haewonkim/.codex/RTK.md && sed -n '1,240p' /Users/haewonkim/.codex/law.md && sed -n '1,260p' company_ui/ai/construction_manifest.json && sed -n '1,260p' AGENTS.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk git status --short --branch
rtk git log -1 --format='%H%n%T%n%P%n%D'
rtk git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main
rtk sed -n '1,260p' .github/workflows/quality.yml
rtk rg -n \"Fabric|evidence|runtime-owned|project_id|operation=VERIFY|CHG-42|quality\" -S . --glob '"'!**/.git/**'"' --glob '"'!*.pyc'"' --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' | head -240

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk nl -ba .github/workflows/quality.yml | sed -n '1,420p'
printf '\\n--- workflow tail ---\\n'

rtk rg -n --hidden --glob '"'!**/.git/**'"' --glob '"'!*.pyc'"' --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!showcase/**'"' --glob '"'!*.html'"' '(runtime-owned|project_id|operation.?=.?VERIFY|request.?=.?CHG|Fabric evidence|fabric evidence|publish.*evidence|evidence.*publish|job_id)' . /Users/haewonkim/.codex-fabric 2>/dev/null | head -260"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk sed -n '260,340p' .github/workflows/quality.yml
printf '\\n--- existing Quality runs for exact main ---\\n'
rtk gh run list --repo kimhw8084/visembler --workflow quality.yml --branch main --limit 10 --json databaseId,number,headSha,event,status,conclusion,createdAt,updatedAt,workflowName,displayTitle,url
printf '\\n--- fabric workspace control files ---\\n'
rtk find /Users/haewonkim/.codex-fabric -maxdepth 2 -type f -not -path '*/results/*' -print | head -120
printf '\\n--- relevant local command names ---\\n'
rtk command -v fabric || true
rtk command -v codex-fabric || true
rtk rg -n --hidden --glob '"'!results/**'"' --glob '"'!**/.git/**'"' '(runtime-owned|project_id|operation|job_id)' /Users/haewonkim/.codex-fabric 2>/dev/null | head -160"

/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- workflow job declarations ---'
rtk rg -n '"'^  [A-Za-z0-9_-]+:|''^    name:|''^    needs:'"' .github/workflows/quality.yml
printf '%s\\n' '--- fabric bins and jobs ---'
rtk ls -la /Users/haewonkim/.codex-fabric/bin 2>/dev/null || true
rtk ls -la /Users/haewonkim/.codex-fabric/libexec | sed -n '1,120p'
rtk ls -la /Users/haewonkim/.codex-fabric/jobs | tail -80
printf '%s\\n' '--- current job references ---'
rtk rg -n --hidden --glob '"'!**/.git/**'"' 'CF-aca10acd66a6234b8d385013|visembler-chg42-postmerge-quality-r8|CHG-42-r8' /Users/haewonkim/.codex-fabric/jobs /Users/haewonkim/.codex-fabric/results /Users/haewonkim/.codex-fabric/evidence 2>/dev/null | head -160
printf '%s\\n' '--- evidence publishing entry points ---'
rtk rg -n 'publish_evidence|runtime-owned|canonical.*evidence|job_id' /Users/haewonkim/.codex-fabric/libexec /Users/haewonkim/.codex-fabric/state/finalize-1.2.2.UDtM20/pkg 2>/dev/null | head -220"

/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- current Fabric job metadata ---'
rtk sed -n '1,220p' /Users/haewonkim/.codex-fabric/jobs/CF-aca10acd66a6234b8d385013.running/job.json

rtk ls -la /Users/haewonkim/.codex-fabric/results/CF-aca10acd66a6234b8d385013 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk gh workflow run quality.yml --repo kimhw8084/visembler --ref main
rtk gh run list --repo kimhw8084/visembler --workflow quality.yml --branch main --event workflow_dispatch --limit 5 --json databaseId,number,headSha,event,status,conclusion,createdAt,updatedAt,workflowName,displayTitle,url'

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk sleep 15
rtk gh run view 35684116267 --repo kimhw8084/visembler --json workflowName,number,headSha,event,status,conclusion,jobs --jq '{workflowName,number,headSha,event,status,conclusion,jobs: [.jobs[] | {databaseId,name,status,conclusion}]}'"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk sleep 30
rtk gh run view 35684116267 --repo kimhw8084/visembler --json workflowName,number,headSha,event,status,conclusion,jobs --jq '{workflowName,number,headSha,event,status,conclusion,jobs: [.jobs[] | {databaseId,name,status,conclusion}]}'"

/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- final exact-main git identity ---'
rtk git status --short --branch
rtk git rev-parse HEAD
rtk git rev-parse HEAD"'^{tree}
rtk git rev-parse HEAD''^@ | tr '"'\\n' ' '

rtk git merge-base --is-ancestor bc8c233a35bc14d48c3c760e709f6097ec6f8e61 HEAD && echo 'accepted-head-is-ancestor=true'

rtk git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main
printf '%s\\n' '--- exact dispatched Quality run ---'
rtk gh run view 35684116267 --repo kimhw8084/visembler --json databaseId,number,name,workflowName,displayTitle,headBranch,headSha,event,status,conclusion,createdAt,startedAt,updatedAt,url,jobs --jq '{databaseId,number,name,workflowName,displayTitle,headBranch,headSha,event,status,conclusion,createdAt,startedAt,updatedAt,url,jobs: [.jobs[] | {databaseId,name,status,conclusion,startedAt,completedAt}]}'

rtk sed -n '1,80p' /Users/haewonkim/.codex-fabric/jobs/CF-aca10acd66a6234b8d385013.running/job.json
rtk /Users/haewonkim/.codex-fabric/bin/fabricctl status CF-aca10acd66a6234b8d385013"
